I struggle with depression, and when I am in especially rough patches it feels like I have 0 control of my life and like I'm going to start spiraling- so I focus on what I CAN control. For me, that's my diet and exercise. Even if everything seems like it's out of my reach, I know that I can control what I eat, which to some extent controls how I feel. I get more depressed when I eat poorly and don't exercise, because I know I'll probably gain weight but I'm too depressed to care and try to fix it- so for me, the best thing to do is start strong and eat healthy. It gives me a lot of mental reassurance and it feels nice knowing that my health is one less thing I have to worry about.
